items.title: Lonnie Liston Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 9, 2021
items.q: I mean in London they should have a statue, they should have knighted Jimi Hendrix, I mean Jimi Hendrix went to London that saved all those rock & roll groups

ctx.x: Yeah. I’m afraid that’s happened a number of times before too, even with rock & roll.

Oh my goodness you’re right. That’s a good example. I mean in London they should have a statue, they should have knighted Jimi Hendrix, I mean Jimi Hendrix went to London that saved all those rock & roll groups that are making millions of dollars a day.
Have you ever had critics or journalists say something about your music that you read, and going that wasn’t the idea at all? Or something along those lines?
